queries.text: 2024 2025 United States moved force sale ban TikTok primarily due national security concerns regarding potential Chinese government access user data platform's algorithm under CFIUS review
2024 April President Biden signed Protecting Americans Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act requiring ByteDance divest operations within roughly days extendable additional face domestic ban
2025 dispute resolved through Oracle-led deal announced June
agreement structured operations joint venture rather outright sale Vice President Vance leading White House negotiations
Under arrangement ByteDance retained majority interest Oracle received stake TikTok's operations joined SoftBank other investors
2025 Following initial enforcement pause via executive order January delayed action seventy-five days final ownership structure completed through app remaining live

search_hits.title: The US TikTok divest-or-ban saga (2024-2025)
search_hits.snippet: The US moved to force TikTok's sale or ban it between 2024 and 2025; an Oracle-led joint-venture deal resolved it.
